[PREFERENCE] User is curious about wood chip options that would pair well with fish or poultry.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Alder wood chips are a classic pairing for fish, especially salmon and trout, adding a subtle, sweet flavor.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Cherry wood chips impart a fruity, slightly sweet flavor that complements fish like salmon, halibut, or snapper.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Maple wood chips add a mild, sweet flavor suitable for milder fish like cod, tilapia, or catfish.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Beech wood chips have a slightly sweet, nutty flavor that pairs well with oily fish like mackerel or sardines.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Hickory wood chips add a strong, savory flavor perfect for BBQ-style smoking of poultry.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Pecan wood chips have a rich, nutty flavor that complements poultry like chicken, turkey, or duck.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Oak wood chips add a strong, earthy flavor that pairs well with game birds like pheasant or quail.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Mesquite wood chips have a strong, sweet flavor suitable for bold, gamey poultry like duck or goose.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Grapevine wood chips have a fruity, slightly sweet flavor that pairs well with poultry or fish.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Orange wood chips add a bright, citrusy flavor perfect for poultry or fish with a Mediterranean twist.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Lemon wood chips have a light, citrusy flavor that pairs well with delicate fish like sole or flounder.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Tips for smoking include soaking wood chips in water for at least 30 minutes, mixing different types of wood chips, and experimenting with smoking temperatures and times.

[PREFERENCE] User is curious if alder wood pairs well with citrus-herb butter.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Alder wood pairs well with citrus-herb butter, enhancing the flavor of salmon without overpowering it.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Citrus-herb butter can balance the richness of salmon, with recommended herbs including parsley, dill, or thyme.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Aromatics like lemon slices, orange zest, or fresh herbs can be added to the smoker for additional flavor.
